mentions.name: Beginner Android Programming Book
mentions.description: A self-published beginner Android programming book written in markdown and converted to print-ready PDF with Pandoc, currently being updated to add more Kotlin examples.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I finally completed my self published beginner Android programming book earlier this year. I took a break and now I'm working on updating it to add more Kotlin examples.
I wrote the book in markdown and used Pandoc to convert it to print ready PDF.
